payload.text: **THE M2 FIX IS HELD UNTIL hv RULES IT INTO 3.2.4; vc's RECOMMENDATION IS IN IF dc SIZES IT AT S OR LESS.** M2 is the line a first v2 conversion prints, "this project has not been migrated to Intent v3", on the line before its ok:. 3.2.2 shipped it documented as option (b), at docs/migrating-from-v2.md:18, which tells the reader the ok: line is the verdict, and a935fd25c's board diff put "the removable-v2-source fix" on the list for the next release. THE SIZING IS UNDER WAY ON vc's ORDER (doing 123), PAUSED FOR hv's COMPACT CYCLE AFTER ITS SOURCE READ AND BEFORE ITS DRIVE.
